capabilities: Show recently modified files grouped by calendar day
Mark files edited outside Obsidian's editor with a colored dot
Pin notes to a persistent Pinned section
Exclude or background folders from the list
Copy a file's absolute filesystem path to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a recently-opened-files list; it tracks modifications, and the README explicitly contrasts this with Recent Files plugins.
extras: Offers an event contract (recent-edits:plugin-write) so other plugins can declare housekeeping writes; the full contract lives in docs/plugin-write-contract.md rather than the README. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; copying absolute paths is desktop only.
motivation: The author uses the vault together with AI tools and wanted to see recently modified files and tell in-editor edits apart from filesystem, sync, or plugin writes.
problem: Recent-files lists show what you opened, not what changed, so edits from scripts, AI assistants, or sync are invisible and indistinguishable from your own.
summary: Sidebar panel that lists recently modified vault files grouped by day and marks edits that came from outside Obsidian's editor.
